parameters.content: Gmail path for Dyzania Triage. Polls the +triage alias every minute, runs the Triage Core, then: creates a threaded Gmail DRAFT (only when the rules allow one; never sends), writes a metadata-only log row and one metadata-only ops event, applies Triage/* labels and, for urgent mail, emails an alert that has no message text. There is no node that sends to a sender. Run the manual branch below once to create the labels. Execution data is not saved.
